title: Handling Graffiti on Masonry & Concrete
subtitle: Innovations in Graffiti Control
blurb: Graffiti vandalism poses a persistent challenge for masonry and concrete assets. This session covers new-generation coatings—from sacrificial barriers to durable, breathable permanent systems—designed to prevent and simplify removal on porous mineral substrates. We’ll review materials science, real-world case studies, and performance data to help you select systems that protect architectural integrity, enhance durability, and reduce lifecycle maintenance costs.
